fitAnalysis.assessment:
Your 47% match is a Weak Fit for this Senior Search Algorithms role at Elastic.

**Strengths:**
- Java and Kotlin experience running the Spring Boot settlement service
- PostgreSQL plus Kafka and Redis data-storage experience
- Open-source Kotlin bug fixes and code review practice

**Gaps:**
- No search or vector database experience (Elasticsearch, Solr)
- No HNSW, IVF or search algorithm work
- Concurrency constructs and Java lambdas are not shown

**Recommendation:** Build an Elasticsearch project and contribute to its open-source codebase before applying, so your Java and open-source work reads as search-relevant.

coverLetter:
Priya Raman
Toronto, Canada
priya.raman@example.com
+1 555 0176

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Elastic

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your ad describes a team that wants a search engine with "unparalleled speed and relevance," and speed is a problem I know from the data side. When the payment status API at Lumen Payments was slow, I cut p99 latency from 480 ms to 120 ms by moving hot reads from PostgreSQL to Redis. I'd like to bring that habit of finding the real bottleneck to the Elasticsearch Search Relevance team.

I'm a Senior Software Engineer with 11 years of experience building payment and event-processing services in Java, Kotlin and Python. I designed and ran a Kotlin and Spring Boot settlement service on Kafka, and I led a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month migration from a monolith. That gave me the autonomy, technical design and code review habits you describe for guiding projects from beginning to end. I haven't worked on vector search or HNSW, so I'd be learning that part of the stack, but I come with solid core Java, PostgreSQL experience and the discipline of giving and receiving feedback on APIs. During a career break I contributed small bug fixes to an open-source Kotlin library, which taught me how to work with maintainers I'd never met, and I'm back in full-time engineering and ready to go deeper.

Your team triages community issues and pull requests across continents, over GitHub and async channels, and I'd like to contribute to that work. I'm available to talk whenever suits your team, and I'd welcome the chance to walk through how I'd approach the first few months.

Kind regards,
Priya Raman

applicationEmail.subject: Application: Senior Software Engineer, Priya Raman
applicationEmail.body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I've spent 11 years building payment and event-processing services in Java, Kotlin and Python, including designing and running a settlement service on Kafka and PostgreSQL. That's backend work built on core Java, careful code review and end-to-end ownership of design and delivery, which is what I'd bring to your Elasticsearch team. My CV and cover letter are attached for your review. I'm available for a call any weekday and can start within two weeks of an offer.

Best regards,
Priya Raman
